difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that under the stated flatness and fibre conditions the base change of a dualizing complex is a dualizing complex (author lemma at source lines 4284-4292, label lemma-flat-iso-mod-I). The proof (source lines 4294-4314) verifies the three axioms: boundedness is immediate, finite injective dimension comes from the ideal correspondence and the Noetherian criterion, and the duality axiom from the base change statement for internal homs (proof lines 4294-4313). The ideal correspondence is the substance. H3.
